info.title: Shopiyz Storefront Account API v2
info.description: The existing Native account API. Feature policy, verified ownership and B2B permissions remain authoritative. This document adds no new authentication or business operation.

servers.description: The exact store origin that owns the client, customer session and resources.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: workspace-v1 selects the section workspace. cart-identity-v1 is a Native cookie-only owned/anonymous cart identity projection; OAuth, direct Storefront tokens and cross-origin requests return409. No reservation or checkout creation.

200.description: Native result for the authenticated owner and current store policy.

403.description: Scope, origin, feature or owner permission denied.

404.description: The store or owned resource is unavailable; no cross-owner fallback.

405.description: Unsupported method; HEAD never aliases consuming account GET actions.

409.description: Stale identity/revision, missing Native buyer session, pending document or changed policy.

422.description: Native field or command validation failed.

get.description: Customer resources remain store/owner scoped. Cross-origin OAuth requests additionally require the matching Storefront client token and an allowed origin. Cookie mode is the Native same-origin flow; no implicit account or company adoption.

id.description: Opaque customer-owned session reference, not a session token or database row credential.

nextCursor.description: Offset encoded as a string; null when complete.

returnTo.description: Only an accepted same-origin account/checkout destination.

lines.description: Native quote revision line payload; omit to retain current quote lines. Prices and ownership are recalculated by the Native quote service.

amount.description: Positive Native decimal amount within the authenticated buyer scope outstanding balance.

NativeCustomerSession.name: faprika_customer_session
NativeCustomerSession.description: Existing Native HttpOnly session; name retained for compatibility. Use the same-origin Native login flow.

StorefrontClientToken.name: X-Shopiyz-Storefront-Access-Token
StorefrontClientToken.description: Registered Storefront client, exact store, permitted origin and operation scope. This does not identify a customer.

CustomerOAuth.description: Existing customer authorization-code/PKCE flow. Buyer and shared-identity exceptions are explicitly cookie-only.

x-shopiyz-noncanonical-native-aliases.reason: The current Native router accepts this alias but mutation identity comes from its JSON body. Use canonical POST /gift-registries; do not infer path-ID binding.

x-shopiyz-privacy.ownerSelector: Verified customer credential; request body IDs cannot select another owner.
x-shopiyz-privacy.sessions: Opaque references; token hashes and bearer/session credentials are never profile/session-list fields.
x-shopiyz-privacy.accountErasure: Customer personal data is erased; orders, invoices, payment and legal records are retained by the Native operation.
